summary: Articles (distinct mention URLs) represented by URL-slug words; exact-duplicate headlines collapsed; binary TF-IDF + cosine single-pass time-ordered clustering against active cluster centroids, then a centroid merge pass. Score = independent outlets (a syndicated headline on many domains counts as one voice) + outlets in its busiest 12h window (velocity). URLs without informative slugs (~7%) are dropped.

params.stem: strip plural/possessive trailing s (len>4, not ss/us/is)
